name: Sparse Voxel Octree Raycasting with Image Warping
aliases: Sparse Voxel Octree Raycasting with Image Warping exploiting Frame-to-Frame Coherence
definition: Exploits temporal coherence between consecutive frames to speed up raycasting by reusing pixel coordinates and reprojecting them.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Raycasting with Image Warping accelerates rendering by reprojecting pixels from previous frames to raycast only holes, trading visual smoothness for performance.
